texts.name: Vilma
texts.biography: Shieldmaidens are a special caste among Dwarven women. If a woman decides to become a Shieldmaiden, she forfeits her right to marry and bear children, and severs her blood bonds to family and clan. Instead, she becomes an impartial protector for the community as a whole, often acting as constable and lawkeeper. Though born in Tor-Lindhath, Vilma "Stoneshield" Bjornsdottir is the Shieldmaiden of the southern city of Sudgerd. But there are increasingly frequent times when she finds the loneliness of her function intolerable.

specialty.name: Defenders
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Defenders, Shieldguards, and Mountain Guards by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 10% for every level (rounded up).
